title: /harness/branch/[branch]/[...at]/functions/[entity]
responsibility: Shows one function at a branch tip or a selected commit: its contract, size, performance and what proves it.

outputs.name: +page
outputs.description: The whole markup this page renders: HarnessScreen with the title 'Function' and EntityBehaviorScreen as its content. The file declares no props and no data loading, so everything shown comes from those two components.

outputs.name: title
outputs.description: The title this page passes to HarnessScreen as its title prop: the constant 'Function' in this file. The file reads no route parameters, so the value does not change with the branch, the at segments or the entity; how HarnessScreen uses it is not shown here.
